notes.agrum: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.genfer: Genfer answers dice2genfer.py's translation of the Dice program in floating point, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.geni: Geni computes in single precision and prints seven decimals, so differences of up to 5e-8 from the reference are its print precision.
notes.libdai: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pgmpy: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pluck: The time is the whole process's, with Julia loading Pluck; the tables take Pluck's own time, the warm one where it ran a second time in the process, else the in-process one.
notes.prism: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value. The time includes the JVM's start.
notes.psi: Psi answers dice2psi.py's translation of the Dice program exactly, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.scallop: Scallop keeps every proof of each tuple (its top-k proofs at the largest k its command line takes), so its answer is exact. The time includes tddlog's grounding of the program, which Scallop reads.
notes.storm: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value.
notes.tensorinference: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads; the time is the whole process's, and the tables take its own, timed as Alea.jl's after a warm-up on a small model (warm-up s): the warm one where it solved the instance a second time in the process (where the first took under a third of the limit), else the in-process one less Julia's compilation within it (compile s); without Julia's start and the package's load, with the search for a contraction order.

notes.pluck: The time is the whole process's, with Julia loading Pluck; the tables take Pluck's own time, the warm one where it ran a second time in the process, else the in-process one.

notes.psi: Psi answers dice2psi.py's translation of the Dice program exactly, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.scallop: Scallop keeps every proof of each tuple (its top-k proofs at the largest k its command line takes), so its answer is exact. The time includes tddlog's grounding of the program, which Scallop reads.
notes.storm: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value.
notes.tensorinference: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads; the time is the whole process's, and the tables take its own, timed as Alea.jl's after a warm-up on a small model (warm-up s): the warm one where it solved the instance a second time in the process (where the first took under a third of the limit), else the in-process one less Julia's compilation within it (compile s); without Julia's start and the package's load, with the search for a contraction order.

notes.agrum: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.genfer: Genfer answers dice2genfer.py's translation of the Dice program in floating point, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.geni: Geni computes in single precision and prints seven decimals, so differences of up to 5e-8 from the reference are its print precision.
notes.libdai: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pgmpy: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pluck: The time is the whole process's, with Julia loading Pluck; the tables take Pluck's own time, the warm one where it ran a second time in the process, else the in-process one.
notes.prism: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value. The time includes the JVM's start.
notes.psi: Psi answers dice2psi.py's translation of the Dice program exactly, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.scallop: Scallop keeps every proof of each tuple (its top-k proofs at the largest k its command line takes), so its answer is exact. The time includes tddlog's grounding of the program, which Scallop reads.
notes.storm: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value.
notes.tensorinference: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads; the time is the whole process's, and the tables take its own, timed as Alea.jl's after a warm-up on a small model (warm-up s): the warm one where it solved the instance a second time in the process (where the first took under a third of the limit), else the in-process one less Julia's compilation within it (compile s); without Julia's start and the package's load, with the search for a contraction order.

notes.agrum: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.genfer: Genfer answers dice2genfer.py's translation of the Dice program in floating point, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.

notes.libdai: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pgmpy: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pluck: The time is the whole process's, with Julia loading Pluck; the tables take Pluck's own time, the warm one where it ran a second time in the process, else the in-process one.

notes.psi: Psi answers dice2psi.py's translation of the Dice program exactly, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.scallop: Scallop keeps every proof of each tuple (its top-k proofs at the largest k its command line takes), so its answer is exact. The time includes tddlog's grounding of the program, which Scallop reads.
notes.storm: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value.
notes.tensorinference: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads; the time is the whole process's, and the tables take its own, timed as Alea.jl's after a warm-up on a small model (warm-up s): the warm one where it solved the instance a second time in the process (where the first took under a third of the limit), else the in-process one less Julia's compilation within it (compile s); without Julia's start and the package's load, with the search for a contraction order.

notes.agrum: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.genfer: Genfer answers dice2genfer.py's translation of the Dice program in floating point, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.geni: Geni computes in single precision and prints seven decimals, so differences of up to 5e-8 from the reference are its print precision.
notes.libdai: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pgmpy: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pluck: The time is the whole process's, with Julia loading Pluck; the tables take Pluck's own time, the warm one where it ran a second time in the process, else the in-process one.
notes.prism: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value. The time includes the JVM's start.
notes.psi: Psi answers dice2psi.py's translation of the Dice program exactly, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.scallop: Scallop keeps every proof of each tuple (its top-k proofs at the largest k its command line takes), so its answer is exact. The time includes tddlog's grounding of the program, which Scallop reads.
notes.storm: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value.
notes.tensorinference: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads; the time is the whole process's, and the tables take its own, timed as Alea.jl's after a warm-up on a small model (warm-up s): the warm one where it solved the instance a second time in the process (where the first took under a third of the limit), else the in-process one less Julia's compilation within it (compile s); without Julia's start and the package's load, with the search for a contraction order.

# Ported from examples/gcd_8.jl of Tractables/Alea.jl,
# branch arithmetic, commit 7e9ff23517086eb4518845e50218bf18b4d9f2a5
# (Apache License 2.0). Mechanical port: Dice -> Alea, @dice -> @alea, the
# BenchmarkTools harness dropped, the query moved to QUERY.
# Cao, Garg, Holtzen, Van den Broeck, Millstein (UAI 2023), Table 1: gcd-small.
using Alea

const QUERY = :pr

function unsafesubtract(x::DistUInt{W}, y::DistUInt{W}) where W
    z = Vector{AnyBool}(undef, W)
    borrow = false
    for i=W:-1:1
        z[i] = xor(x.bits[i], y.bits[i], borrow)
        borrow = ifelse(borrow, !x.bits[i] | y.bits[i], !x.bits[i] & y.bits[i])
    end
    DistUInt{W}(z)
end

function unsafemod(p1::DistUInt{W}, p2::DistUInt{W}) where W
    p1_proxy = DistUInt{W}(0)
    for i = 1:W
        p1_proxy = DistUInt{W}(vcat(p1_proxy.bits[2:W], p1.bits[i]))
        p1_proxy = ifelse(p2 > p1_proxy, p1_proxy, unsafesubtract(p1_proxy,p2))
    end
    p1_proxy
end

function gcd(a::DistUInt{W}, b::DistUInt{W}) where W
    for _ = 1 : 1 + W ÷ log2(MathConstants.golden)
        amb = unsafemod(a, b)
        amb = ifelse(prob_equals(amb, DistUInt{W}(0)), b, amb)
        b, a = amb, b
    end
    return a
end

function uniform_interleaved(n, k; reverse=false)
    m = Matrix(undef, n+1, k)
    m[1,:] .= false
    for i=1:n
        order = reverse ? (k:-1:1) : (1:k)
        for j=order
            m[i+1,j] = flip(0.5)
        end
    end
    [mapslices(v -> DistUInt{n+1}(v), m; dims=[1])...]
end

function uniform_coprime(n)
    DInt = DistUInt{n+1}
    b, a = uniform_interleaved(n, 2; reverse=false)
    a += DInt(1)
    b += DInt(1)
    g = gcd(a, b)
    prob_equals(g, DInt(1))
end

model() = uniform_coprime(8)

(define (bxor a b) (! (<=> a b)))
(define (bv-add xs ys [c #f])

(define (bv-sub xs ys) (bv-add xs (map ! ys) #t))
(define (bv-mul xs ys)
  (define w (length xs))
  (for/fold ([acc (make-list w #f)]) ([y (in-list ys)] [i (in-naturals)])
    (if (eq? y #f)
        acc
        (bv-add acc (append (make-list i #f) (for/list ([x (in-list (take xs (- w i)))]) (&& y x)))))))
(define (bv-eq xs ys) (apply && (map <=> xs ys)))
(define (bv-ult xs ys)
  (for/fold ([lt #f]) ([x (in-list xs)] [y (in-list ys)])
    (|| (&& (! x) y) (&& (<=> x y) lt))))
(define (bv-shl xs k)
  (define w (length xs))
  (take (append (make-list (min k w) #f) xs) w))

;; bit k is a flip whose probability is the mass of the values with bit k
;; set among those that agree on the bits above, over their mass; one flip
;; for each distinct ratio, chosen by the bits above, settings of no mass
;; left out.
(define (discrete w ps)
  (define size (expt 2 w))
  (define given (list->vector ps))
  (define masses
    (for/vector ([i (in-range size)])
      (if (< i (vector-length given)) (inexact->exact (vector-ref given i)) 0)))
  (define (mass lo hi) (for/sum ([i (in-range lo hi)]) (vector-ref masses i)))
  (let level ([k (sub1 w)] [above '()])
    (cond
      [(< k 0) (reverse above)]
      [else
       (define span (expt 2 (add1 k)))
       (define flips (make-hash))
       (define table
         (for/vector ([u (in-range (quotient size span))])
           (define lo (* u span))
           (define total (mass lo (+ lo span)))
           (cond
             [(zero? total) 'none]
             [else
              (define r (exact->inexact (/ (mass (+ lo (quotient span 2)) (+ lo span)) total)))

    [(null? vals) #f]
    [(andmap (λ (x) (eq? x (car vals))) vals) (car vals)]
    [else
     (define half (quotient (vector-length table) 2))

         (choose (cdr above) (vector-copy table 0 half)))]))

#lang roulette/example/disrupt
;; arith_gcd_medium.dice, translated by tddlog's scripts/dice2roulette.py.

(require racket/port racket/string)

;; A statement of the program: a definition, which the language does not
;; run as a query of its own (it runs each expression of the module as one).
(define-syntax-rule (statement e ...) (define-values () (begin e ... (values))))

;; Integers: lists of Booleans, least significant bit first.
(define (bxor a b) (! (<=> a b)))
(define (bv-add xs ys [c #f])
  (if (null? xs)
      '()
      (let* ([x (car xs)] [y (car ys)] [s (bxor x y)])
        (cons (bxor s c) (bv-add (cdr xs) (cdr ys) (|| (&& x y) (&& c s)))))))
(define (bv-sub xs ys) (bv-add xs (map ! ys) #t))
(define (bv-mul xs ys)
  (define w (length xs))
  (for/fold ([acc (make-list w #f)]) ([y (in-list ys)] [i (in-naturals)])
    (if (eq? y #f)
        acc
        (bv-add acc (append (make-list i #f) (for/list ([x (in-list (take xs (- w i)))]) (&& y x)))))))
(define (bv-eq xs ys) (apply && (map <=> xs ys)))
(define (bv-ult xs ys)
  (for/fold ([lt #f]) ([x (in-list xs)] [y (in-list ys)])
    (|| (&& (! x) y) (&& (<=> x y) lt))))
(define (bv-shl xs k)
  (define w (length xs))
  (take (append (make-list (min k w) #f) xs) w))
(define (bv-shr xs k)
  (define j (min k (length xs)))
  (append (drop xs j) (make-list j #f)))

;; Dice's categorical (gen_discrete): from the most significant bit down,
;; bit k is a flip whose probability is the mass of the values with bit k
;; set among those that agree on the bits above, over their mass; one flip
;; for each distinct ratio, chosen by the bits above, settings of no mass
;; left out.
(define (discrete w ps)
  (define size (expt 2 w))
  (define given (list->vector ps))
  (define masses
    (for/vector ([i (in-range size)])
      (if (< i (vector-length given)) (inexact->exact (vector-ref given i)) 0)))
  (define (mass lo hi) (for/sum ([i (in-range lo hi)]) (vector-ref masses i)))
  (let level ([k (sub1 w)] [above '()])
    (cond
      [(< k 0) (reverse above)]
      [else
       (define span (expt 2 (add1 k)))
       (define flips (make-hash))
       (define table
         (for/vector ([u (in-range (quotient size span))])
           (define lo (* u span))
           (define total (mass lo (+ lo span)))
           (cond
             [(zero? total) 'none]
             [else
              (define r (exact->inexact (/ (mass (+ lo (quotient span 2)) (+ lo span)) total)))
              (hash-ref! flips r (λ () (cond [(= r 0) #f] [(= r 1) #t] [else (flip r)])))])))
       (level (sub1 k) (append above (list (choose above table))))])))
;; The entry of table for the setting of the bits `above` (most significant
;; first), constant where every setting of mass agrees.
(define (choose above table)
  (define vals (for/list ([x (in-vector table)] #:unless (eq? x 'none)) x))
  (cond
    [(null? vals) #f]
    [(andmap (λ (x) (eq? x (car vals))) vals) (car vals)]
    [else
     (define half (quotient (vector-length table) 2))
     (if (car above)
         (choose (cdr above) (vector-copy table half))
         (choose (cdr above) (vector-copy table 0 half)))]))
(define (uniform w lo hi)
  (discrete w (for/list ([i (in-range hi)]) (if (< i lo) 0.0 (exact->inexact (/ 1 (- hi lo)))))))

(define (bits->natural bs)
  (for/sum ([b (in-list bs)] [i (in-naturals)]) (if b (expt 2 i) 0)))
(define (real p) (if (exact? p) (exact->inexact p) p))
;; Racket's `time` around the program's statements and its queries.
(define (start-clock)
  (vector (current-process-milliseconds) (current-inexact-milliseconds) (current-gc-milliseconds)))
(define (print-time c)
  (printf "cpu time: ~a real time: ~a gc time: ~a\n"
          (- (current-process-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 0))
          (inexact->exact (round (- (current-inexact-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 1))))
          (- (current-gc-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 2))))

;; The distribution of v, a list of (value . probability): Roulette's query
;; at the module's level (`display-pmf`), read back from the table it
;; prints, or from the one value it prints alone.
(define (distribution v)
  (define text (with-output-to-string (λ () (display-pmf v))))
  (define (datum s)
    (define d (read (open-input-string s)))
    (if (and (pair? d) (eq? (car d) 'quote)) (cadr d) d))
  (define rows
    (for/list ([line (in-list (string-split text "\n"))]
               #:when (regexp-match? #rx"[│|]" line))
      (filter (λ (s) (not (string=? s ""))) (map string-trim (regexp-split #rx"[│|]" line)))))
  (if (null? rows)
      (list (cons (datum text) 1))
      (for/list ([r (in-list rows)]
                 #:unless (equal? r '("Value" "Probability")))
        (cons (datum (car r)) (string->number (cadr r))))))
;; (Not cond's `=>`: the language binds `=>` to Rosette's implication.)
(define (probability dist v)
  (define e (assoc v dist))
  (if e (cdr e) 0))
(define (report-bool k dist)
  (printf "roulette ~a true ~a\n" k (real (probability dist #t)))
  (printf "roulette ~a false ~a\n" k (real (probability dist #f))))
(define (report-int k dist w)
  (define by-value (make-hash))
  (for ([vp (in-list dist)])
    (hash-set! by-value (bits->natural (car vp)) (cdr vp)))
  (for ([i (in-range (expt 2 w))])
    (printf "roulette ~a ~a ~a\n" k i (real (hash-ref by-value i 0)))))
;; The components' distributions in order, from 1: a Boolean's where its
;; width is #f, else an int's of that width.
(define (report dists widths)
  (for ([dist (in-list dists)] [w (in-list widths)] [k (in-naturals 1)])
    (if w (report-int k dist w) (report-bool k dist))))

(define (f-divide x1-s)
  (define x2-b (car x1-s))
  (define x3-rest (car (cadr x1-s)))
  (define x4-shifted (bv-shl (cadr (cadr x1-s)) 1))
  (define x5-r (list-ref x3-rest 10))
  (define x7-r (if x5-r (let ()
  (define x6-r (bv-add x4-shifted '(#t #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f)))
  x6-r) x4-shifted))
  (define x8-divide (bv-ult x7-r x2-b))
  (define x10-divide (if x8-divide x7-r (let ()
  (define x9-divide (bv-sub x7-r x2-b))
  x9-divide)))
  (define x11-divide (list x2-b (list (bv-shl x3-rest 1) x10-divide)))
  x11-divide)

(define (f-round x12-s)
  (define x13-a (car x12-s))
  (define x14-b (cadr x12-s))
  (define x15-m (list x14-b (list x13-a '(#f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f))))
  (define x17-m (for/fold ([x16-state x15-m]) ([_ (in-range 11)]) (f-divide x16-state)))
  (define x18-m (cadr (cadr x17-m)))
  (define x19-round (bv-eq x18-m '(#f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f)))
  (define x20-round (list x14-b (if x19-round x14-b x18-m)))
  x20-round)

(define clock (start-clock))
(define x21-a (uniform 11 0 1024))
(define x22-a (bv-add x21-a '(#t #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f)))
(define x23-b (uniform 11 0 1024))
(define x24-b (bv-add x23-b '(#t #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f)))
(define x25-result (list x22-a x24-b))
(define x27-result (for/fold ([x26-state x25-result]) ([_ (in-range 16)]) (f-round x26-state)))
(define x28-result (bv-eq (car x27-result) '(#t #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f)))
(define dists (list (distribution x28-result)))
(statement (print-time clock))
(statement (report dists '(#f)))

# Ported from examples/gcd_10.jl of Tractables/Alea.jl,
# branch arithmetic, commit 7e9ff23517086eb4518845e50218bf18b4d9f2a5
# (Apache License 2.0). Mechanical port: Dice -> Alea, @dice -> @alea, the
# BenchmarkTools harness dropped, the query moved to QUERY.
# Cao, Garg, Holtzen, Van den Broeck, Millstein (UAI 2023), Table 1: gcd-medium.
using Alea

const QUERY = :pr

function unsafesubtract(x::DistUInt{W}, y::DistUInt{W}) where W
    z = Vector{AnyBool}(undef, W)
    borrow = false
    for i=W:-1:1
        z[i] = xor(x.bits[i], y.bits[i], borrow)
        borrow = ifelse(borrow, !x.bits[i] | y.bits[i], !x.bits[i] & y.bits[i])
    end
    DistUInt{W}(z)
end

function unsafemod(p1::DistUInt{W}, p2::DistUInt{W}) where W
    p1_proxy = DistUInt{W}(0)
    for i = 1:W
        p1_proxy = DistUInt{W}(vcat(p1_proxy.bits[2:W], p1.bits[i]))
        p1_proxy = ifelse(p2 > p1_proxy, p1_proxy, unsafesubtract(p1_proxy,p2))
    end
    p1_proxy
end

function gcd(a::DistUInt{W}, b::DistUInt{W}) where W
    for _ = 1 : 1 + W ÷ log2(MathConstants.golden)
        amb = unsafemod(a, b)
        amb = ifelse(prob_equals(amb, DistUInt{W}(0)), b, amb)
        b, a = amb, b
    end
    return a
end

function uniform_interleaved(n, k; reverse=false)
    m = Matrix(undef, n+1, k)
    m[1,:] .= false
    for i=1:n
        order = reverse ? (k:-1:1) : (1:k)
        for j=order
            m[i+1,j] = flip(0.5)
        end
    end
    [mapslices(v -> DistUInt{n+1}(v), m; dims=[1])...]
end

function uniform_coprime(n)
    DInt = DistUInt{n+1}
    b, a = uniform_interleaved(n, 2; reverse=false)
    a += DInt(1)
    b += DInt(1)
    g = gcd(a, b)
    prob_equals(g, DInt(1))
end

model() = uniform_coprime(10)

;; arith_gcd_large.dice, translated by tddlog's scripts/dice2roulette.py.

(require racket/port racket/string)

;; A statement of the program: a definition, which the language does not
;; run as a query of its own (it runs each expression of the module as one).
(define-syntax-rule (statement e ...) (define-values () (begin e ... (values))))

;; Integers: lists of Booleans, least significant bit first.
(define (bxor a b) (! (<=> a b)))
(define (bv-add xs ys [c #f])
  (if (null? xs)
      '()
      (let* ([x (car xs)] [y (car ys)] [s (bxor x y)])
        (cons (bxor s c) (bv-add (cdr xs) (cdr ys) (|| (&& x y) (&& c s)))))))
(define (bv-sub xs ys) (bv-add xs (map ! ys) #t))
(define (bv-mul xs ys)
  (define w (length xs))
  (for/fold ([acc (make-list w #f)]) ([y (in-list ys)] [i (in-naturals)])
    (if (eq? y #f)
        acc
        (bv-add acc (append (make-list i #f) (for/list ([x (in-list (take xs (- w i)))]) (&& y x)))))))
(define (bv-eq xs ys) (apply && (map <=> xs ys)))
(define (bv-ult xs ys)
  (for/fold ([lt #f]) ([x (in-list xs)] [y (in-list ys)])
    (|| (&& (! x) y) (&& (<=> x y) lt))))
(define (bv-shl xs k)
  (define w (length xs))
  (take (append (make-list (min k w) #f) xs) w))
(define (bv-shr xs k)
  (define j (min k (length xs)))
  (append (drop xs j) (make-list j #f)))

;; Dice's categorical (gen_discrete): from the most significant bit down,
;; bit k is a flip whose probability is the mass of the values with bit k
;; set among those that agree on the bits above, over their mass; one flip
;; for each distinct ratio, chosen by the bits above, settings of no mass
;; left out.
(define (discrete w ps)
  (define size (expt 2 w))
  (define given (list->vector ps))
  (define masses
    (for/vector ([i (in-range size)])
      (if (< i (vector-length given)) (inexact->exact (vector-ref given i)) 0)))
  (define (mass lo hi) (for/sum ([i (in-range lo hi)]) (vector-ref masses i)))
  (let level ([k (sub1 w)] [above '()])
    (cond
      [(< k 0) (reverse above)]
      [else
       (define span (expt 2 (add1 k)))
       (define flips (make-hash))
       (define table
         (for/vector ([u (in-range (quotient size span))])
           (define lo (* u span))
           (define total (mass lo (+ lo span)))
           (cond
             [(zero? total) 'none]
             [else
              (define r (exact->inexact (/ (mass (+ lo (quotient span 2)) (+ lo span)) total)))
              (hash-ref! flips r (λ () (cond [(= r 0) #f] [(= r 1) #t] [else (flip r)])))])))
       (level (sub1 k) (append above (list (choose above table))))])))
;; The entry of table for the setting of the bits `above` (most significant
;; first), constant where every setting of mass agrees.
(define (choose above table)
  (define vals (for/list ([x (in-vector table)] #:unless (eq? x 'none)) x))
  (cond
    [(null? vals) #f]
    [(andmap (λ (x) (eq? x (car vals))) vals) (car vals)]
    [else
     (define half (quotient (vector-length table) 2))
     (if (car above)
         (choose (cdr above) (vector-copy table half))
         (choose (cdr above) (vector-copy table 0 half)))]))
(define (uniform w lo hi)
  (discrete w (for/list ([i (in-range hi)]) (if (< i lo) 0.0 (exact->inexact (/ 1 (- hi lo)))))))

(define (bits->natural bs)
  (for/sum ([b (in-list bs)] [i (in-naturals)]) (if b (expt 2 i) 0)))
(define (real p) (if (exact? p) (exact->inexact p) p))
;; Racket's `time` around the program's statements and its queries.
(define (start-clock)
  (vector (current-process-milliseconds) (current-inexact-milliseconds) (current-gc-milliseconds)))
(define (print-time c)
  (printf "cpu time: ~a real time: ~a gc time: ~a\n"
          (- (current-process-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 0))
          (inexact->exact (round (- (current-inexact-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 1))))
          (- (current-gc-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 2))))

;; The distribution of v, a list of (value . probability): Roulette's query
;; at the module's level (`display-pmf`), read back from the table it
;; prints, or from the one value it prints alone.
(define (distribution v)
  (define text (with-output-to-string (λ () (display-pmf v))))
  (define (datum s)
    (define d (read (open-input-string s)))
    (if (and (pair? d) (eq? (car d) 'quote)) (cadr d) d))
  (define rows
    (for/list ([line (in-list (string-split text "\n"))]
               #:when (regexp-match? #rx"[│|]" line))
      (filter (λ (s) (not (string=? s ""))) (map string-trim (regexp-split #rx"[│|]" line)))))
  (if (null? rows)
      (list (cons (datum text) 1))
      (for/list ([r (in-list rows)]
                 #:unless (equal? r '("Value" "Probability")))
        (cons (datum (car r)) (string->number (cadr r))))))
;; (Not cond's `=>`: the language binds `=>` to Rosette's implication.)
(define (probability dist v)
  (define e (assoc v dist))
  (if e (cdr e) 0))
(define (report-bool k dist)
  (printf "roulette ~a true ~a\n" k (real (probability dist #t)))
  (printf "roulette ~a false ~a\n" k (real (probability dist #f))))
(define (report-int k dist w)
  (define by-value (make-hash))
  (for ([vp (in-list dist)])
    (hash-set! by-value (bits->natural (car vp)) (cdr vp)))
  (for ([i (in-range (expt 2 w))])
    (printf "roulette ~a ~a ~a\n" k i (real (hash-ref by-value i 0)))))
;; The components' distributions in order, from 1: a Boolean's where its
;; width is #f, else an int's of that width.
(define (report dists widths)
  (for ([dist (in-list dists)] [w (in-list widths)] [k (in-naturals 1)])
    (if w (report-int k dist w) (report-bool k dist))))

(define (f-divide x1-s)
  (define x2-b (car x1-s))
  (define x3-rest (car (cadr x1-s)))
  (define x4-shifted (bv-shl (cadr (cadr x1-s)) 1))
  (define x5-r (list-ref x3-rest 12))
  (define x7-r (if x5-r (let ()
  (define x6-r (bv-add x4-shifted '(#t #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f)))
  x6-r) x4-shifted))
  (define x8-divide (bv-ult x7-r x2-b))
  (define x10-divide (if x8-divide x7-r (let ()
  (define x9-divide (bv-sub x7-r x2-b))
  x9-divide)))
  (define x11-divide (list x2-b (list (bv-shl x3-rest 1) x10-divide)))
  x11-divide)

(define (f-round x12-s)
  (define x13-a (car x12-s))
  (define x14-b (cadr x12-s))
  (define x15-m (list x14-b (list x13-a '(#f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f))))
  (define x17-m (for/fold ([x16-state x15-m]) ([_ (in-range 13)]) (f-divide x16-state)))
  (define x18-m (cadr (cadr x17-m)))
  (define x19-round (bv-eq x18-m '(#f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f)))
  (define x20-round (list x14-b (if x19-round x14-b x18-m)))
  x20-round)

(define clock (start-clock))
(define x21-a (uniform 13 0 4096))
(define x22-a (bv-add x21-a '(#t #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f)))
(define x23-b (uniform 13 0 4096))
(define x24-b (bv-add x23-b '(#t #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f)))
(define x25-result (list x22-a x24-b))
(define x27-result (for/fold ([x26-state x25-result]) ([_ (in-range 19)]) (f-round x26-state)))
(define x28-result (bv-eq (car x27-result) '(#t #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f)))
(define dists (list (distribution x28-result)))
(statement (print-time clock))
(statement (report dists '(#f)))

# Ported from experiments/dicejl/ranking_medium.jl of Tractables/Alea.jl,
# branch arithmetic, commit 7e9ff23517086eb4518845e50218bf18b4d9f2a5
# (Apache License 2.0). Mechanical port: Dice -> Alea, @dice -> @alea, the
# BenchmarkTools harness dropped, the query moved to QUERY.
# Cao, Garg, Holtzen, Van den Broeck, Millstein (UAI 2023), Table 1: ranking-medium.
using Alea

const QUERY = :pr

model() = @alea begin
    uniq_count = 4
    bits = Int(floor(log2(uniq_count)) + 4)

    rankings = [[3, 2, 1, 0],
                [1, 3, 2, 0],
                [1, 2, 3, 0]]

    ranks = [uniform(DistInt{bits}, 0, uniq_count) for i in 1:uniq_count]
    for i in 1:uniq_count
        for j in i+1:uniq_count
            observe(!prob_equals(ranks[i], ranks[j]))
        end
    end


    for data in rankings
        obs_rank = [x + uniform(DistInt{bits}, -uniq_count, uniq_count+1) for x in ranks]
        for i in 1:uniq_count-1
            a, b = data[i]+1, data[i+1] + 1
            observe(obs_rank[a] < obs_rank[b])
        end
    end

    (ranks[1], ranks[2], ranks[3], ranks[4])
end

  (let level ([k (sub1 w)] [above '()])
    (cond
      [(< k 0) (reverse above)]
      [else
       (define span (expt 2 (add1 k)))
       (define flips (make-hash))
       (define table
         (for/vector ([u (in-range (quotient size span))])
           (define lo (* u span))
           (define total (mass lo (+ lo span)))
           (cond
             [(zero? total) 'none]
             [else
              (define r (exact->inexact (/ (mass (+ lo (quotient span 2)) (+ lo span)) total)))

;; first), constant where every setting of mass agrees.
(define (choose above table)
  (define vals (for/list ([x (in-vector table)] #:unless (eq? x 'none)) x))
  (cond
    [(null? vals) #f]
    [(andmap (λ (x) (eq? x (car vals))) vals) (car vals)]
    [else
     (define half (quotient (vector-length table) 2))
     (if (car above)
         (choose (cdr above) (vector-copy table half))
         (choose (cdr above) (vector-copy table 0 half)))]))
(define (uniform w lo hi)
  (discrete w (for/list ([i (in-range hi)]) (if (< i lo) 0.0 (exact->inexact (/ 1 (- hi lo)))))))

(define (bits->natural bs)
  (for/sum ([b (in-list bs)] [i (in-naturals)]) (if b (expt 2 i) 0)))

(define (start-clock)

(define (print-time c)
  (printf "cpu time: ~a real time: ~a gc time: ~a\n"
          (- (current-process-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 0))
          (inexact->exact (round (- (current-inexact-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 1))))
          (- (current-gc-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 2))))

;; The distribution of v, a list of (value . probability): Roulette's query
;; at the module's level (`display-pmf`), read back from the table it
;; prints, or from the one value it prints alone.
(define (distribution v)
  (define text (with-output-to-string (λ () (display-pmf v))))
  (define (datum s)
    (define d (read (open-input-string s)))
    (if (and (pair? d) (eq? (car d) 'quote)) (cadr d) d))
  (define rows
    (for/list ([line (in-list (string-split text "\n"))]
               #:when (regexp-match? #rx"[│|]" line))
      (filter (λ (s) (not (string=? s ""))) (map string-trim (regexp-split #rx"[│|]" line)))))
  (if (null? rows)
      (list (cons (datum text) 1))
      (for/list ([r (in-list rows)]
                 #:unless (equal? r '("Value" "Probability")))
        (cons (datum (car r)) (string->number (cadr r))))))

(define (probability dist v)
  (define e (assoc v dist))
  (if e (cdr e) 0))

  (define by-value (make-hash))

  (for ([i (in-range (expt 2 w))])
    (printf "roulette ~a ~a ~a\n" k i (real (hash-ref by-value i 0)))))

;; arith_triangle_medium.dice, translated by tddlog's scripts/dice2roulette.py.

(require racket/port racket/string)

;; A statement of the program: a definition, which the language does not
;; run as a query of its own (it runs each expression of the module as one).
(define-syntax-rule (statement e ...) (define-values () (begin e ... (values))))

;; Integers: lists of Booleans, least significant bit first.
(define (bxor a b) (! (<=> a b)))
(define (bv-add xs ys [c #f])
  (if (null? xs)
      '()
      (let* ([x (car xs)] [y (car ys)] [s (bxor x y)])
        (cons (bxor s c) (bv-add (cdr xs) (cdr ys) (|| (&& x y) (&& c s)))))))
(define (bv-sub xs ys) (bv-add xs (map ! ys) #t))
(define (bv-mul xs ys)
  (define w (length xs))
  (for/fold ([acc (make-list w #f)]) ([y (in-list ys)] [i (in-naturals)])
    (if (eq? y #f)
        acc
        (bv-add acc (append (make-list i #f) (for/list ([x (in-list (take xs (- w i)))]) (&& y x)))))))
(define (bv-eq xs ys) (apply && (map <=> xs ys)))
(define (bv-ult xs ys)
  (for/fold ([lt #f]) ([x (in-list xs)] [y (in-list ys)])
    (|| (&& (! x) y) (&& (<=> x y) lt))))
(define (bv-shl xs k)
  (define w (length xs))
  (take (append (make-list (min k w) #f) xs) w))
(define (bv-shr xs k)
  (define j (min k (length xs)))
  (append (drop xs j) (make-list j #f)))

;; Dice's categorical (gen_discrete): from the most significant bit down,
;; bit k is a flip whose probability is the mass of the values with bit k
;; set among those that agree on the bits above, over their mass; one flip
;; for each distinct ratio, chosen by the bits above, settings of no mass
;; left out.
(define (discrete w ps)
  (define size (expt 2 w))
  (define given (list->vector ps))
  (define masses
    (for/vector ([i (in-range size)])
      (if (< i (vector-length given)) (inexact->exact (vector-ref given i)) 0)))
  (define (mass lo hi) (for/sum ([i (in-range lo hi)]) (vector-ref masses i)))
  (let level ([k (sub1 w)] [above '()])
    (cond
      [(< k 0) (reverse above)]
      [else
       (define span (expt 2 (add1 k)))
       (define flips (make-hash))
       (define table
         (for/vector ([u (in-range (quotient size span))])
           (define lo (* u span))
           (define total (mass lo (+ lo span)))
           (cond
             [(zero? total) 'none]
             [else
              (define r (exact->inexact (/ (mass (+ lo (quotient span 2)) (+ lo span)) total)))
              (hash-ref! flips r (λ () (cond [(= r 0) #f] [(= r 1) #t] [else (flip r)])))])))
       (level (sub1 k) (append above (list (choose above table))))])))
;; The entry of table for the setting of the bits `above` (most significant
;; first), constant where every setting of mass agrees.
(define (choose above table)
  (define vals (for/list ([x (in-vector table)] #:unless (eq? x 'none)) x))
  (cond
    [(null? vals) #f]
    [(andmap (λ (x) (eq? x (car vals))) vals) (car vals)]
    [else
     (define half (quotient (vector-length table) 2))
     (if (car above)
         (choose (cdr above) (vector-copy table half))
         (choose (cdr above) (vector-copy table 0 half)))]))
(define (uniform w lo hi)
  (discrete w (for/list ([i (in-range hi)]) (if (< i lo) 0.0 (exact->inexact (/ 1 (- hi lo)))))))

(define (bits->natural bs)
  (for/sum ([b (in-list bs)] [i (in-naturals)]) (if b (expt 2 i) 0)))
(define (real p) (if (exact? p) (exact->inexact p) p))
;; Racket's `time` around the program's statements and its queries.
(define (start-clock)
  (vector (current-process-milliseconds) (current-inexact-milliseconds) (current-gc-milliseconds)))
(define (print-time c)
  (printf "cpu time: ~a real time: ~a gc time: ~a\n"
          (- (current-process-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 0))
          (inexact->exact (round (- (current-inexact-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 1))))
          (- (current-gc-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 2))))

;; The distribution of v, a list of (value . probability): Roulette's query
;; at the module's level (`display-pmf`), read back from the table it
;; prints, or from the one value it prints alone.
(define (distribution v)
  (define text (with-output-to-string (λ () (display-pmf v))))
  (define (datum s)
    (define d (read (open-input-string s)))
    (if (and (pair? d) (eq? (car d) 'quote)) (cadr d) d))
  (define rows
    (for/list ([line (in-list (string-split text "\n"))]
               #:when (regexp-match? #rx"[│|]" line))
      (filter (λ (s) (not (string=? s ""))) (map string-trim (regexp-split #rx"[│|]" line)))))
  (if (null? rows)
      (list (cons (datum text) 1))
      (for/list ([r (in-list rows)]
                 #:unless (equal? r '("Value" "Probability")))
        (cons (datum (car r)) (string->number (cadr r))))))
;; (Not cond's `=>`: the language binds `=>` to Rosette's implication.)
(define (probability dist v)
  (define e (assoc v dist))
  (if e (cdr e) 0))
(define (report-bool k dist)
  (printf "roulette ~a true ~a\n" k (real (probability dist #t)))
  (printf "roulette ~a false ~a\n" k (real (probability dist #f))))
(define (report-int k dist w)
  (define by-value (make-hash))
  (for ([vp (in-list dist)])
    (hash-set! by-value (bits->natural (car vp)) (cdr vp)))
  (for ([i (in-range (expt 2 w))])
    (printf "roulette ~a ~a ~a\n" k i (real (hash-ref by-value i 0)))))

(define (f-lt x1-x x2-y)
  (define x3-lt (bv-ult (bv-add x1-x '(#f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #t)) (bv-add x2-y '(#f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #t))))
  x3-lt)

(define (f-le x4-x x5-y)
  (define x6-le (f-lt x5-y x4-x))
  (define x7-le (! x6-le))
  x7-le)

(define clock (start-clock))
(define x8-a (uniform 15 0 201))
(define x9-a (bv-sub x8-a '(#f #f #t #f #f #t #t #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f)))
(define x10-b (uniform 15 0 201))
(define x11-b (bv-sub x10-b '(#f #f #t #f #f #t #t #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f)))
(define x12-c (uniform 15 0 201))
(define x13-c (bv-sub x12-c '(#f #f #t #f #f #t #t #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f)))
(define x14-result (f-le x9-a '(#f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f)))
(define x15-result (f-le x11-b '(#f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f)))
(define x16-result (f-le x13-c '(#f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f #f)))
(define x17-result (|| (|| x14-result x15-result) x16-result))
(define x27-result (if x17-result '(#t #t) (let ()
  (define x18-result (f-le (bv-add x9-a x11-b) x13-c))
  (define x19-result (f-le (bv-add x9-a x13-c) x11-b))
  (define x20-result (f-le (bv-add x11-b x13-c) x9-a))
  (define x21-result (|| (|| x18-result x19-result) x20-result))
  (define x26-result (if x21-result '(#t #t) (let ()
  (define x22-result (&& (&& (bv-eq x9-a x11-b) (bv-eq x9-a x13-c)) (bv-eq x11-b x13-c)))
  (define x25-result (if x22-result '(#f #t) (let ()
  (define x23-result (|| (|| (bv-eq x9-a x11-b) (bv-eq x9-a x13-c)) (bv-eq x11-b x13-c)))
  (define x24-result (if x23-result '(#t #f) '(#f #f)))
  x24-result)))
  x25-result)))
  x26-result)))
(define dists (list (distribution x27-result)))
(statement (print-time clock))
(statement (report-int 1 (list-ref dists 0) 2))

using Alea

model() = @alea begin
    function binomial(n::DistUInt{W}, p, max::Int) where W
        output = DistUInt{W}(0)
        for i in 0:max-1
            output += ifelse((DistUInt{W}(i)<n) & flip(p), DistUInt{W}(1), DistUInt{W}(0))
        end
        return output
    end

    nummet = binomial(param, 0.5, 500)
    numinfected = binomial(nummet, 0.3, 500)
    numinfected
end

# Cao, Garg, Holtzen, Van den Broeck, Millstein (UAI 2023), Table 1: linext-large.
using Alea

const QUERY = :pr

model() = @alea begin

    uniq_count = 8

    bits = Int(floor(log2(uniq_count)) + 4)
    partial = [[1, 2],
        [3, 2],
        [1, 4],
        [5, 8],
        [6, 5],
        [3, 4]]

    ranks = [uniform(DistInt{bits}, 0, uniq_count) for i in 1:uniq_count]
    for i in 1:uniq_count
        for j in i+1:uniq_count
            observe(!prob_equals(ranks[i], ranks[j]))
        end
    end


    for comp in partial
        observe(ranks[comp[1]] < ranks[comp[2]])
    end

    (ranks[1], ranks[2], ranks[3], ranks[4], ranks[5], ranks[6], ranks[7], ranks[8])
end

# Ported from experiments/dicejl/fw_medium.jl of Tractables/Alea.jl,
# branch arithmetic, commit 7e9ff23517086eb4518845e50218bf18b4d9f2a5
# (Apache License 2.0). Mechanical port: Dice -> Alea, @dice -> @alea, the
# BenchmarkTools harness dropped, the query moved to QUERY.
# Cao, Garg, Holtzen, Van den Broeck, Millstein (UAI 2023), Table 1: floydwarshall-medium.
using Alea

const QUERY = :pr

model() = @alea begin
    num_nodes = 6
    MAX = 3 * num_nodes * num_nodes
    w = Int(floor(log2(MAX))) + 2

    edges = Dict(
        (1, 2) => uniform(DistUInt{w}, 1, 3),
        (1, 3) => uniform(DistUInt{w}, 1, 5),
        (1, 6) => uniform(DistUInt{w}, 1, 11),
        (2, 3) => uniform(DistUInt{w}, 1, 3),
        (2, 5) => uniform(DistUInt{w}, 1, 7),
        (3, 5) => uniform(DistUInt{w}, 1, 5),
        (4, 5) => uniform(DistUInt{w}, 1, 3),
        (5, 6) => uniform(DistUInt{w}, 1, 3)
    )

    distance = [[DistUInt{w}(MAX) for j in 1:num_nodes] for i in 1:num_nodes]


    for edge in edges
        coord, dist = edge[1], edge[2]
        distance[coord[1]][coord[2]] = dist
        distance[coord[2]][coord[1]] = dist
    end

    for i in 1:num_nodes
        distance[i][i] = DistUInt{w}(0)
    end

    for k in 1:num_nodes
        for i in 1:num_nodes
            for j in 1:num_nodes
                distance[i][j] = ifelse(distance[i][j] > distance[i][k]+distance[k][j], distance[i][k]+distance[k][j], distance[i][j])
            end
        end
    end

    distance[1][6]
end

# Ported from experiments/dicejl/radar.jl of Tractables/Alea.jl,
# branch arithmetic, commit 7e9ff23517086eb4518845e50218bf18b4d9f2a5
# (Apache License 2.0). Mechanical port: Dice -> Alea, @dice -> @alea, the
# BenchmarkTools harness dropped, the query moved to QUERY.
# Cao, Garg, Holtzen, Van den Broeck, Millstein (UAI 2023), Table 1: radar1.
using Alea

const QUERY = :pr

model() = @alea begin
    w = 10

    function T(mu, l, r)
        x = uniform(DistInt{w}, -l, 1) + uniform(DistInt{w}, 0, l+1)
        y = uniform(DistInt{w}, -r, 1) + uniform(DistInt{w}, 0, r+1)
        observe(x <= DistInt{w}(0) && y > DistInt{w}(0))

        return ifelse(flip(l/(l+r)), x, y) + mu
    end

    b1 = flip(0.2)
    b2 = ifelse(b1, true, flip(0.2))
    x1 = uniform(DistInt{w}, 0, 11)
    x2 = uniform(DistInt{w}, -2, 3) + x1

    o1 = x1 + ifelse(b1, T(x1, 5, 1), T(x1, 5, 5))
    o2 = x2 + ifelse(b2, T(x2, 5, 1), T(x2, 5, 5))

    observe(o1 == DistInt{w}(5));
    observe(b1)

    x2

    # T(DistInt{w}(0), 5, 5)
end

(define (bxor a b) (! (<=> a b)))

(require racket/port racket/string)

;; A statement of the program: a definition, which the language does not
;; run as a query of its own (it runs each expression of the module as one).
(define-syntax-rule (statement e ...) (define-values () (begin e ... (values))))

;; Integers: lists of Booleans, least significant bit first.
(define (bxor a b) (! (<=> a b)))
(define (bv-add xs ys [c #f])
  (if (null? xs)
      '()
      (let* ([x (car xs)] [y (car ys)] [s (bxor x y)])
        (cons (bxor s c) (bv-add (cdr xs) (cdr ys) (|| (&& x y) (&& c s)))))))
(define (bv-sub xs ys) (bv-add xs (map ! ys) #t))
(define (bv-mul xs ys)
  (define w (length xs))
  (for/fold ([acc (make-list w #f)]) ([y (in-list ys)] [i (in-naturals)])
    (if (eq? y #f)
        acc
        (bv-add acc (append (make-list i #f) (for/list ([x (in-list (take xs (- w i)))]) (&& y x)))))))
(define (bv-eq xs ys) (apply && (map <=> xs ys)))
(define (bv-ult xs ys)
  (for/fold ([lt #f]) ([x (in-list xs)] [y (in-list ys)])
    (|| (&& (! x) y) (&& (<=> x y) lt))))
(define (bv-shl xs k)
  (define w (length xs))
  (take (append (make-list (min k w) #f) xs) w))
(define (bv-shr xs k)
  (define j (min k (length xs)))
  (append (drop xs j) (make-list j #f)))

;; Dice's categorical (gen_discrete): from the most significant bit down,
;; bit k is a flip whose probability is the mass of the values with bit k
;; set among those that agree on the bits above, over their mass; one flip
;; for each distinct ratio, chosen by the bits above, settings of no mass
;; left out.
(define (discrete w ps)
  (define size (expt 2 w))
  (define given (list->vector ps))
  (define masses
    (for/vector ([i (in-range size)])
      (if (< i (vector-length given)) (inexact->exact (vector-ref given i)) 0)))
  (define (mass lo hi) (for/sum ([i (in-range lo hi)]) (vector-ref masses i)))
  (let level ([k (sub1 w)] [above '()])
    (cond
      [(< k 0) (reverse above)]
      [else
       (define span (expt 2 (add1 k)))
       (define flips (make-hash))
       (define table
         (for/vector ([u (in-range (quotient size span))])
           (define lo (* u span))
           (define total (mass lo (+ lo span)))
           (cond
             [(zero? total) 'none]
             [else
              (define r (exact->inexact (/ (mass (+ lo (quotient span 2)) (+ lo span)) total)))
              (hash-ref! flips r (λ () (cond [(= r 0) #f] [(= r 1) #t] [else (flip r)])))])))
       (level (sub1 k) (append above (list (choose above table))))])))
;; The entry of table for the setting of the bits `above` (most significant
;; first), constant where every setting of mass agrees.
(define (choose above table)
  (define vals (for/list ([x (in-vector table)] #:unless (eq? x 'none)) x))
  (cond
    [(null? vals) #f]
    [(andmap (λ (x) (eq? x (car vals))) vals) (car vals)]
    [else
     (define half (quotient (vector-length table) 2))
     (if (car above)
         (choose (cdr above) (vector-copy table half))
         (choose (cdr above) (vector-copy table 0 half)))]))
(define (uniform w lo hi)
  (discrete w (for/list ([i (in-range hi)]) (if (< i lo) 0.0 (exact->inexact (/ 1 (- hi lo)))))))

(define (bits->natural bs)
  (for/sum ([b (in-list bs)] [i (in-naturals)]) (if b (expt 2 i) 0)))
(define (real p) (if (exact? p) (exact->inexact p) p))

(define (start-clock)

(define (print-time c)
  (printf "cpu time: ~a real time: ~a gc time: ~a\n"
          (- (current-process-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 0))
          (inexact->exact (round (- (current-inexact-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 1))))
          (- (current-gc-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 2))))

;; The distribution of v, a list of (value . probability): Roulette's query
;; at the module's level (`display-pmf`), read back from the table it
;; prints, or from the one value it prints alone.
(define (distribution v)
  (define text (with-output-to-string (λ () (display-pmf v))))
  (define (datum s)
    (define d (read (open-input-string s)))
    (if (and (pair? d) (eq? (car d) 'quote)) (cadr d) d))
  (define rows
    (for/list ([line (in-list (string-split text "\n"))]
               #:when (regexp-match? #rx"[│|]" line))
      (filter (λ (s) (not (string=? s ""))) (map string-trim (regexp-split #rx"[│|]" line)))))
  (if (null? rows)
      (list (cons (datum text) 1))

# Ported from experiments/dicejl/fw_large.jl of Tractables/Alea.jl,
# branch arithmetic, commit 7e9ff23517086eb4518845e50218bf18b4d9f2a5
# (Apache License 2.0). Mechanical port: Dice -> Alea, @dice -> @alea, the
# BenchmarkTools harness dropped, the query moved to QUERY.
# Cao, Garg, Holtzen, Van den Broeck, Millstein (UAI 2023), Table 1: floydwarshall-large.
using Alea

const QUERY = :pr

model() = @alea begin
    num_nodes = 8
    MAX = num_nodes * 3 * num_nodes
    w = Int(floor(log2(MAX))) + 2
    edge_list = [[0, 2],
    [0, 4],
    [0, 5],
    [0, 6],
    [1, 4],
    [1, 6],
    [2, 3],
    [2, 7],
    [3, 6],
    [3, 7],
    [4, 7],
    [5, 6],
    [6, 7]]
    edges = Dict()

    for edge in edge_list
        diff = edge[2] - edge[1]
        half = Int(floor((diff/2)))
        edges[(edge[1]+1, edge[2]+1)] = uniform(DistUInt{w}, 1, 2*diff+1)
    end


    distance = [[DistUInt{w}(MAX) for j in 1:num_nodes] for i in 1:num_nodes]


    for edge in edges
        coord, dist = edge[1], edge[2]
        distance[coord[1]][coord[2]] = dist
        distance[coord[2]][coord[1]] = dist
    end

    for i in 1:num_nodes
        distance[i][i] = DistUInt{w}(0)
    end


    for k in 1:num_nodes
        for i in 1:num_nodes
            for j in 1:num_nodes
                distance[i][j] = ifelse(distance[i][j] > distance[i][k]+distance[k][j], distance[i][k]+distance[k][j], distance[i][j])
            end
        end
    end

    distance[1][8]
end

# Ported from experiments/dicejl/linext_medium.jl of Tractables/Alea.jl,
# branch arithmetic, commit 7e9ff23517086eb4518845e50218bf18b4d9f2a5
# (Apache License 2.0). Mechanical port: Dice -> Alea, @dice -> @alea, the
# BenchmarkTools harness dropped, the query moved to QUERY.
# Cao, Garg, Holtzen, Van den Broeck, Millstein (UAI 2023), Table 1: linext-medium.
using Alea

const QUERY = :pr

model() = @alea begin

    uniq_count = 6

    bits = Int(floor(log2(uniq_count)) + 4)
    partial = [[2, 4], [3, 4], [3, 1], [4, 5], [1, 5]]

    ranks = [uniform(DistInt{bits}, 0, uniq_count) for i in 1:uniq_count]
    for i in 1:uniq_count
        for j in i+1:uniq_count
            observe(!prob_equals(ranks[i], ranks[j]))
        end
    end


    for comp in partial
        observe(ranks[comp[1]] < ranks[comp[2]])
    end

    (ranks[1], ranks[2], ranks[3], ranks[4], ranks[5], ranks[6])
end

#lang roulette/example/disrupt
;; luhn_medium.dice, translated by tddlog's scripts/dice2roulette.py.

(require racket/port racket/string)

;; A statement of the program: a definition, which the language does not
;; run as a query of its own (it runs each expression of the module as one).
(define-syntax-rule (statement e ...) (define-values () (begin e ... (values))))

;; Integers: lists of Booleans, least significant bit first.
(define (bxor a b) (! (<=> a b)))
(define (bv-add xs ys [c #f])
  (if (null? xs)
      '()
      (let* ([x (car xs)] [y (car ys)] [s (bxor x y)])
        (cons (bxor s c) (bv-add (cdr xs) (cdr ys) (|| (&& x y) (&& c s)))))))
(define (bv-sub xs ys) (bv-add xs (map ! ys) #t))
(define (bv-mul xs ys)
  (define w (length xs))
  (for/fold ([acc (make-list w #f)]) ([y (in-list ys)] [i (in-naturals)])
    (if (eq? y #f)
        acc
        (bv-add acc (append (make-list i #f) (for/list ([x (in-list (take xs (- w i)))]) (&& y x)))))))
(define (bv-eq xs ys) (apply && (map <=> xs ys)))
(define (bv-ult xs ys)
  (for/fold ([lt #f]) ([x (in-list xs)] [y (in-list ys)])
    (|| (&& (! x) y) (&& (<=> x y) lt))))
(define (bv-shl xs k)
  (define w (length xs))
  (take (append (make-list (min k w) #f) xs) w))
(define (bv-shr xs k)
  (define j (min k (length xs)))
  (append (drop xs j) (make-list j #f)))

;; Dice's categorical (gen_discrete): from the most significant bit down,
;; bit k is a flip whose probability is the mass of the values with bit k
;; set among those that agree on the bits above, over their mass; one flip
;; for each distinct ratio, chosen by the bits above, settings of no mass
;; left out.
(define (discrete w ps)
  (define size (expt 2 w))
  (define given (list->vector ps))
  (define masses
    (for/vector ([i (in-range size)])
      (if (< i (vector-length given)) (inexact->exact (vector-ref given i)) 0)))
  (define (mass lo hi) (for/sum ([i (in-range lo hi)]) (vector-ref masses i)))
  (let level ([k (sub1 w)] [above '()])
    (cond
      [(< k 0) (reverse above)]
      [else
       (define span (expt 2 (add1 k)))
       (define flips (make-hash))
       (define table
         (for/vector ([u (in-range (quotient size span))])
           (define lo (* u span))
           (define total (mass lo (+ lo span)))
           (cond
             [(zero? total) 'none]
             [else
              (define r (exact->inexact (/ (mass (+ lo (quotient span 2)) (+ lo span)) total)))
              (hash-ref! flips r (λ () (cond [(= r 0) #f] [(= r 1) #t] [else (flip r)])))])))
       (level (sub1 k) (append above (list (choose above table))))])))
;; The entry of table for the setting of the bits `above` (most significant
;; first), constant where every setting of mass agrees.
(define (choose above table)
  (define vals (for/list ([x (in-vector table)] #:unless (eq? x 'none)) x))
  (cond
    [(null? vals) #f]
    [(andmap (λ (x) (eq? x (car vals))) vals) (car vals)]
    [else
     (define half (quotient (vector-length table) 2))
     (if (car above)
         (choose (cdr above) (vector-copy table half))
         (choose (cdr above) (vector-copy table 0 half)))]))
(define (uniform w lo hi)
  (discrete w (for/list ([i (in-range hi)]) (if (< i lo) 0.0 (exact->inexact (/ 1 (- hi lo)))))))

(define (bits->natural bs)
  (for/sum ([b (in-list bs)] [i (in-naturals)]) (if b (expt 2 i) 0)))
(define (real p) (if (exact? p) (exact->inexact p) p))
;; Racket's `time` around the program's statements and its queries.
(define (start-clock)
  (vector (current-process-milliseconds) (current-inexact-milliseconds) (current-gc-milliseconds)))
(define (print-time c)
  (printf "cpu time: ~a real time: ~a gc time: ~a\n"
          (- (current-process-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 0))
          (inexact->exact (round (- (current-inexact-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 1))))
          (- (current-gc-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 2))))

;; The distribution of v, a list of (value . probability): Roulette's query
;; at the module's level (`display-pmf`), read back from the table it
;; prints, or from the one value it prints alone.
(define (distribution v)
  (define text (with-output-to-string (λ () (display-pmf v))))
  (define (datum s)
    (define d (read (open-input-string s)))
    (if (and (pair? d) (eq? (car d) 'quote)) (cadr d) d))
  (define rows
    (for/list ([line (in-list (string-split text "\n"))]
               #:when (regexp-match? #rx"[│|]" line))
      (filter (λ (s) (not (string=? s ""))) (map string-trim (regexp-split #rx"[│|]" line)))))
  (if (null? rows)
      (list (cons (datum text) 1))
      (for/list ([r (in-list rows)]
                 #:unless (equal? r '("Value" "Probability")))
        (cons (datum (car r)) (string->number (cadr r))))))
;; (Not cond's `=>`: the language binds `=>` to Rosette's implication.)
(define (probability dist v)
  (define e (assoc v dist))
  (if e (cdr e) 0))
(define (report-bool k dist)
  (printf "roulette ~a true ~a\n" k (real (probability dist #t)))
  (printf "roulette ~a false ~a\n" k (real (probability dist #f))))
(define (report-int k dist w)
  (define by-value (make-hash))
  (for ([vp (in-list dist)])
    (hash-set! by-value (bits->natural (car vp)) (cdr vp)))
  (for ([i (in-range (expt 2 w))])
    (printf "roulette ~a ~a ~a\n" k i (real (hash-ref by-value i 0)))))

(define (f-double x1-x)
  (define x2-double (bv-ult '(#f #f #t #f #f #f #f) x1-x))
  (define x5-double (if x2-double (let ()
  (define x3-double (bv-sub (bv-mul '(#f #t #f #f #f #f #f) x1-x) '(#t #f #f #t #f #f #f)))
  x3-double) (let ()
  (define x4-double (bv-mul '(#f #t #f #f #f #f #f) x1-x))
  x4-double)))
  x5-double)

(define clock (start-clock))
(define x6-id1 (uniform 7 0 10))
(define x7-id2 (uniform 7 0 10))
(define x8-id3 (uniform 7 0 10))
(define x9-id4 (uniform 7 0 10))
(define x10-id5 (uniform 7 0 10))
(define x11-id6 (uniform 7 0 10))
(define x12-seen1 (flip 0.5))
(define x14-seen1 (if x12-seen1 (let ()
  (define x13-seen1 (bv-eq x6-id1 '(#f #t #f #f #f #f #f)))
  x13-seen1) #t))
(statement (observe! x14-seen1))
(define x15-seen2 (flip 0.5))
(define x17-seen2 (if x15-seen2 (let ()
  (define x16-seen2 (bv-eq x7-id2 '(#f #f #f #f #f #f #f)))
  x16-seen2) #t))
(statement (observe! x17-seen2))
(define x18-seen3 (flip 0.5))
(define x20-seen3 (if x18-seen3 (let ()
  (define x19-seen3 (bv-eq x8-id3 '(#t #f #t #f #f #f #f)))
  x19-seen3) #t))
(statement (observe! x20-seen3))
(define x21-seen4 (flip 0.5))
(define x23-seen4 (if x21-seen4 (let ()
  (define x22-seen4 (bv-eq x9-id4 '(#f #t #t #f #f #f #f)))
  x22-seen4) #t))
(statement (observe! x23-seen4))
(define x24-seen5 (flip 0.5))
(define x26-seen5 (if x24-seen5 (let ()
  (define x25-seen5 (bv-eq x10-id5 '(#f #f #f #f #f #f #f)))
  x25-seen5) #t))
(statement (observe! x26-seen5))
(define x27-seen6 (flip 0.5))
(define x29-seen6 (if x27-seen6 (let ()
  (define x28-seen6 (bv-eq x11-id6 '(#f #f #f #f #f #f #f)))
  x28-seen6) #t))
(statement (observe! x29-seen6))
(define x30-sum (f-double x8-id3))
(define x31-sum (f-double x10-id5))
(define x32-sum (bv-add (bv-add (bv-add (bv-add x7-id2 x30-sum) x9-id4) x31-sum) x11-id6))
(define x33-mod (! (bv-ult x32-sum '(#f #f #f #t #f #t #f))))
(define x44-mod (if x33-mod (let ()
  (define x34-mod (bv-sub x32-sum '(#f #f #f #t #f #t #f)))
  x34-mod) (let ()
  (define x35-mod (! (bv-ult x32-sum '(#f #t #t #t #t #f #f))))
  (define x43-mod (if x35-mod (let ()
  (define x36-mod (bv-sub x32-sum '(#f #t #t #t #t #f #f)))
  x36-mod) (let ()
  (define x37-mod (! (bv-ult x32-sum '(#f #f #t #f #t #f #f))))
  (define x42-mod (if x37-mod (let ()
  (define x38-mod (bv-sub x32-sum '(#f #f #t #f #t #f #f)))
  x38-mod) (let ()
  (define x39-mod (! (bv-ult x32-sum '(#f #t #f #t #f #f #f))))
  (define x41-mod (if x39-mod (let ()
  (define x40-mod (bv-sub x32-sum '(#f #t #f #t #f #f #f)))
  x40-mod) x32-sum))
  x41-mod)))

# Ported from examples/gcd_12.jl of Tractables/Alea.jl,
# branch arithmetic, commit 7e9ff23517086eb4518845e50218bf18b4d9f2a5
# (Apache License 2.0). Mechanical port: Dice -> Alea, @dice -> @alea, the
# BenchmarkTools harness dropped, the query moved to QUERY.
# Cao, Garg, Holtzen, Van den Broeck, Millstein (UAI 2023), Table 1: gcd-large.
using Alea

const QUERY = :pr

function unsafesubtract(x::DistUInt{W}, y::DistUInt{W}) where W
    z = Vector{AnyBool}(undef, W)
    borrow = false
    for i=W:-1:1
        z[i] = xor(x.bits[i], y.bits[i], borrow)
        borrow = ifelse(borrow, !x.bits[i] | y.bits[i], !x.bits[i] & y.bits[i])
    end
    DistUInt{W}(z)
end

function unsafemod(p1::DistUInt{W}, p2::DistUInt{W}) where W
    p1_proxy = DistUInt{W}(0)
    for i = 1:W
        p1_proxy = DistUInt{W}(vcat(p1_proxy.bits[2:W], p1.bits[i]))
        p1_proxy = ifelse(p2 > p1_proxy, p1_proxy, unsafesubtract(p1_proxy,p2))
    end
    p1_proxy
end

function gcd(a::DistUInt{W}, b::DistUInt{W}) where W
    for _ = 1 : 1 + W ÷ log2(MathConstants.golden)
        amb = unsafemod(a, b)
        amb = ifelse(prob_equals(amb, DistUInt{W}(0)), b, amb)
        b, a = amb, b
    end
    return a
end

function uniform_interleaved(n, k; reverse=false)
    m = Matrix(undef, n+1, k)
    m[1,:] .= false
    for i=1:n
        order = reverse ? (k:-1:1) : (1:k)
        for j=order
            m[i+1,j] = flip(0.5)
        end
    end
    [mapslices(v -> DistUInt{n+1}(v), m; dims=[1])...]
end

function uniform_coprime(n)
    DInt = DistUInt{n+1}
    b, a = uniform_interleaved(n, 2; reverse=false)
    a += DInt(1)
    b += DInt(1)
    g = gcd(a, b)
    prob_equals(g, DInt(1))
end

# Ported from experiments/dicejl/ranking_small.jl of Tractables/Alea.jl,
# branch arithmetic, commit 7e9ff23517086eb4518845e50218bf18b4d9f2a5
# (Apache License 2.0). Mechanical port: Dice -> Alea, @dice -> @alea, the
# BenchmarkTools harness dropped, the query moved to QUERY.
# Cao, Garg, Holtzen, Van den Broeck, Millstein (UAI 2023), Table 1: ranking-small.
using Alea

const QUERY = :pr

model() = @alea begin
    uniq_count = 4
    bits = Int(floor(log2(uniq_count)) + 4)

    rankings = [[3, 2, 1, 0]]

    ranks = [uniform(DistInt{bits}, 0, uniq_count) for i in 1:uniq_count]
    for i in 1:uniq_count
        for j in i+1:uniq_count
            observe(!prob_equals(ranks[i], ranks[j]))
        end
    end


    for data in rankings
        obs_rank = [x + uniform(DistInt{bits}, -uniq_count, uniq_count+1) for x in ranks]
        for i in 1:uniq_count-1
            a, b = data[i]+1, data[i+1] + 1
            observe(obs_rank[a] < obs_rank[b])
        end
    end

    (ranks[1], ranks[2], ranks[3], ranks[4])
end

#lang roulette/example/disrupt
;; linext_small.dice, translated by tddlog's scripts/dice2roulette.py.

(require racket/port racket/string)

;; A statement of the program: a definition, which the language does not
;; run as a query of its own (it runs each expression of the module as one).
(define-syntax-rule (statement e ...) (define-values () (begin e ... (values))))

;; Integers: lists of Booleans, least significant bit first.
(define (bxor a b) (! (<=> a b)))
(define (bv-add xs ys [c #f])
  (if (null? xs)
      '()
      (let* ([x (car xs)] [y (car ys)] [s (bxor x y)])
        (cons (bxor s c) (bv-add (cdr xs) (cdr ys) (|| (&& x y) (&& c s)))))))
(define (bv-sub xs ys) (bv-add xs (map ! ys) #t))
(define (bv-mul xs ys)
  (define w (length xs))
  (for/fold ([acc (make-list w #f)]) ([y (in-list ys)] [i (in-naturals)])
    (if (eq? y #f)
        acc
        (bv-add acc (append (make-list i #f) (for/list ([x (in-list (take xs (- w i)))]) (&& y x)))))))
(define (bv-eq xs ys) (apply && (map <=> xs ys)))
(define (bv-ult xs ys)
  (for/fold ([lt #f]) ([x (in-list xs)] [y (in-list ys)])
    (|| (&& (! x) y) (&& (<=> x y) lt))))
(define (bv-shl xs k)
  (define w (length xs))
  (take (append (make-list (min k w) #f) xs) w))
(define (bv-shr xs k)
  (define j (min k (length xs)))
  (append (drop xs j) (make-list j #f)))

;; Dice's categorical (gen_discrete): from the most significant bit down,
;; bit k is a flip whose probability is the mass of the values with bit k
;; set among those that agree on the bits above, over their mass; one flip
;; for each distinct ratio, chosen by the bits above, settings of no mass
;; left out.
(define (discrete w ps)
  (define size (expt 2 w))
  (define given (list->vector ps))
  (define masses
    (for/vector ([i (in-range size)])
      (if (< i (vector-length given)) (inexact->exact (vector-ref given i)) 0)))
  (define (mass lo hi) (for/sum ([i (in-range lo hi)]) (vector-ref masses i)))
  (let level ([k (sub1 w)] [above '()])
    (cond
      [(< k 0) (reverse above)]
      [else
       (define span (expt 2 (add1 k)))
       (define flips (make-hash))
       (define table
         (for/vector ([u (in-range (quotient size span))])
           (define lo (* u span))
           (define total (mass lo (+ lo span)))
           (cond
             [(zero? total) 'none]
             [else
              (define r (exact->inexact (/ (mass (+ lo (quotient span 2)) (+ lo span)) total)))
              (hash-ref! flips r (λ () (cond [(= r 0) #f] [(= r 1) #t] [else (flip r)])))])))
       (level (sub1 k) (append above (list (choose above table))))])))
;; The entry of table for the setting of the bits `above` (most significant
;; first), constant where every setting of mass agrees.
(define (choose above table)
  (define vals (for/list ([x (in-vector table)] #:unless (eq? x 'none)) x))
  (cond
    [(null? vals) #f]
    [(andmap (λ (x) (eq? x (car vals))) vals) (car vals)]
    [else
     (define half (quotient (vector-length table) 2))
     (if (car above)
         (choose (cdr above) (vector-copy table half))
         (choose (cdr above) (vector-copy table 0 half)))]))
(define (uniform w lo hi)
  (discrete w (for/list ([i (in-range hi)]) (if (< i lo) 0.0 (exact->inexact (/ 1 (- hi lo)))))))

(define (bits->natural bs)
  (for/sum ([b (in-list bs)] [i (in-naturals)]) (if b (expt 2 i) 0)))
(define (real p) (if (exact? p) (exact->inexact p) p))
;; Racket's `time` around the program's statements and its queries.
(define (start-clock)
  (vector (current-process-milliseconds) (current-inexact-milliseconds) (current-gc-milliseconds)))
(define (print-time c)
  (printf "cpu time: ~a real time: ~a gc time: ~a\n"
          (- (current-process-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 0))
          (inexact->exact (round (- (current-inexact-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 1))))
          (- (current-gc-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 2))))

;; The distribution of v, a list of (value . probability): Roulette's query
;; at the module's level (`display-pmf`), read back from the table it
;; prints, or from the one value it prints alone.
(define (distribution v)
  (define text (with-output-to-string (λ () (display-pmf v))))
  (define (datum s)
    (define d (read (open-input-string s)))
    (if (and (pair? d) (eq? (car d) 'quote)) (cadr d) d))
  (define rows
    (for/list ([line (in-list (string-split text "\n"))]
               #:when (regexp-match? #rx"[│|]" line))
      (filter (λ (s) (not (string=? s ""))) (map string-trim (regexp-split #rx"[│|]" line)))))
  (if (null? rows)
      (list (cons (datum text) 1))
      (for/list ([r (in-list rows)]
                 #:unless (equal? r '("Value" "Probability")))
        (cons (datum (car r)) (string->number (cadr r))))))
;; (Not cond's `=>`: the language binds `=>` to Rosette's implication.)
(define (probability dist v)
  (define e (assoc v dist))
  (if e (cdr e) 0))
(define (report-bool k dist)
  (printf "roulette ~a true ~a\n" k (real (probability dist #t)))
  (printf "roulette ~a false ~a\n" k (real (probability dist #f))))
(define (report-int k dist w)
  (define by-value (make-hash))
  (for ([vp (in-list dist)])
    (hash-set! by-value (bits->natural (car vp)) (cdr vp)))
  (for ([i (in-range (expt 2 w))])
    (printf "roulette ~a ~a ~a\n" k i (real (hash-ref by-value i 0)))))



(define clock (start-clock))
(define x1-r1 (uniform 6 0 4))
(define x2-r2 (uniform 6 0 4))
(define x3-r3 (uniform 6 0 4))
(define x4-r4 (uniform 6 0 4))
(statement (observe! (! (bv-eq x1-r1 x2-r2))))
(statement (observe! (! (bv-eq x1-r1 x3-r3))))
(statement (observe! (! (bv-eq x1-r1 x4-r4))))
(statement (observe! (! (bv-eq x2-r2 x3-r3))))
(statement (observe! (! (bv-eq x2-r2 x4-r4))))
(statement (observe! (! (bv-eq x3-r3 x4-r4))))
(statement (observe! (bv-ult x1-r1 x3-r3)))
(statement (observe! (bv-ult x1-r1 x4-r4)))
(define x5-result (list x1-r1 (list x2-r2 (list x3-r3 x4-r4))))
(define dists (list (distribution (car x5-result)) (distribution (car (cadr x5-result))) (distribution (car (cadr (cadr x5-result)))) (distribution (cadr (cadr (cadr x5-result))))))
(statement (print-time clock))
(statement (report-int 1 (list-ref dists 0) 6))
(statement (report-int 2 (list-ref dists 1) 6))
(statement (report-int 3 (list-ref dists 2) 6))
(statement (report-int 4 (list-ref dists 3) 6))
